Terms of Service

These Terms of Service (“Terms”) govern your installation, access to, and use of HERMES GSuite CLI (“HERMES”, “the software”, or “the CLI”). By installing, downloading, or using HERMES CLI, you agree to be bound by these Terms.

1. Description of Software

HERMES GSuite CLI is a client-side, developer-focused command-line interface written in Python for managing Google Workspace services (such as Gmail, Calendar, Sheets, Docs, Meet, and Forms) directly from a local terminal. HERMES is provided as open-source software and is not a paid software-as-a-service (SaaS) or commercial subscription product.

3. Acceptable Use

You agree to use HERMES CLI only in compliance with all applicable local, national, and international laws, regulations, and third-party terms. Specifically, you agree NOT to use HERMES CLI:

  • To transmit unsolicited commercial email (spam) or engage in email harassment via the Gmail API.
  • To deliberately violate Google's API rate limits or disrupt Google Workspace services.
  • To unlawfully access or exfiltrate accounts or resources belonging to other individuals without authorization.
  • For any malicious, fraudulent, or destructive activity.

4. User Responsibilities & Local Security

Because HERMES GSuite CLI is a client-side tool operating on your local hardware:

  • Protecting Your Environment: You are solely responsible for securing your operating system user account, terminal sessions, and the local files where tokens and credentials are saved (~/.config/gsuite-cli/).
  • Protecting API Credentials: You are responsible for safeguarding your Google Cloud OAuth Client ID, Client Secret, and Gemini API keys. Do not commit your token.json or credentials.json to public version control repositories.
  • Revoking Access: If your machine is lost, stolen, or compromised, you should immediately revoke HERMES' access token via Google Account Security (myaccount.google.com/permissions).

5. Relationship with Google Services

HERMES GSuite CLI is an independent open-source tool and is not endorsed, certified, or sponsored by Google LLC. Google Workspace, Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Drive, Google Sheets, Google Docs, Google Meet, and Google Forms are trademarks of Google LLC.

Your access to Google Workspace through HERMES is governed by your own direct agreements with Google, including the Google Terms of Service and the Google APIs Terms of Service. You are responsible for ensuring that your usage complies with all applicable Google quotas and policies.

6. AI Feature Limitations (Google Gemini)

HERMES GSuite CLI provides optional integration with Google Gemini for natural-language workflows (email summarization, drafting, schedule inquiries). You acknowledge and agree that:

  • Artificial intelligence outputs are probabilistic and generative in nature. AI suggestions, summaries, or drafts may contain inaccuracies or hallucinations.
  • You are solely responsible for reviewing and verifying any AI-generated drafts, responses, or calendar alterations before sending or applying them.
  • The maintainers of HERMES CLI accept no liability for erroneous AI actions or content produced via third-party AI models.
